name: Hexed Pet: Dog
source:
In a world where curses exist, those with a grudge or some sort of evil purpose cause misfortune on others by placing a curse on them. Like this young man, who was cursed into a dog. Forgetting everything about his life as a human, he thinks he's an animal.  Now he behaves like one! 

Micah, due to his abilities, is the only person who is able to see the dog in his true form. a human. The only way for those who are under a curse to turn back to normal is by helping them remember their human identity. So. Who is this man? And why is he cursed? 

Anything could happen when two people live under the same roof. Maybe with the right choices, their relationship will develop. 

[From [url=https://chanimk.itch.io/hexed-pet-dog]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在存在诅咒的世界里，怀有怨恨或某种邪恶目的的人会通过诅咒他人而给他人带来不幸。就像这个被诅咒变成狗的年轻人一样。他忘记了自己作为人类生活的一切，认为自己是动物。现在他的行为就像一个人一样！

由于米卡的能力，他是唯一能够看到狗真实形态的人。一个人。对于那些受到诅咒的人来说，恢复正常的唯一方法就是帮助他们记住自己的人类身份。所以。这个人是谁？而他为什么会被诅咒呢？

当两个人住在同一个屋檐下时，任何事情都有可能发生。也许只要做出正确的选择，他们的关系就会发展。

[来自[url=https://chanimk.itch.io/hexed-pet-dog]itch.io[/url]]
